{{Quote|I'm lecturing on xenometamorphic epidemiology. You're welcome to listen.|Ianna Cel|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Xenometamorphic epidemiology''' was the study of the patterns, causes, and effects of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] diseases that caused major physical transformations in its victims. A primary subject of study in the field was the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ianna Cel]] specialized in the field as part of her work to find a cure for the plague on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Doctor [[Eckard Lokin]] also gave a lecture on the subject.
